component.name: UBI System
component.summary: Managed UBI dashboards for employee estates, presence, and leadership visibility

description.p: UBI System provides a solidly designed GUI for the Managed UBI software, covering estate transparency, employee presence dashboards, and organizational health oversight.
This Flatpak package launches the self-contained web application locally and hosts it inside a native GTK and WebKit window.
First packaged desktop release of the Managed UBI software.

ul.li: Blazor GUI with overview, estate, presence, leadership, and operations workflows.
Native GTK and WebKit Flatpak host window instead of external browser launch.
Local JSON-backed persistence and HTTP APIs for company, employee, and intervention data.
